about.text: Its name is taken from the similarity of its shape to adobe bricks. It is mild and slightly salty to taste. Young Adobera has a soft texture and can be crumbled or cubed. As the cheese matures, its texture becomes more creamy and it can no longer be crumbled. It melts well.
